meaning: Defer the stock camera/PCIe resource-state controller initializer with EFI_UNSUPPORTED before registering its protocol or performing clock, HWIO and sequencer operations.
evidence: v11 reaches RscDxe ENTER without a visible EXIT, followed by a persistent black screen with backlight. Main 0x14E4 installs protocol 3806cdf0-c281-4345-9b1e-49dfb3126923 and invokes its initializer for cam at 0x1558 and pcie at 0x1570. Init 0x1584 maps HWIO, enables camera/PCIe clocks, programs RSC state and disables camera clocks. No other retained stock PE or DEPEX contains this protocol GUID.
limitations: Diagnostic containment, not proof of the internal failing instruction or a functional camera/PCIe RSC implementation. No success is fabricated. The existing ABL hardware state is left untouched by this initializer. Tablet boot and later driver dependencies remain unverified.
